# Ongoing spell source snapshot

`_source/spells24/6th-level/sunbeam.yml` is an unchanged snapshot from
[Foundry D&D5e commit 965ad2d0cf5d063dac675ba078b5bd3c3c0dd449](https://github.com/foundryvtt/dnd5e/blob/965ad2d0cf5d063dac675ba078b5bd3c3c0dd449/packs/_source/spells24/6th-level/sunbeam.yml).
SHA-256: `bb4c819b6510a155dd17001c4e2ac2c5264866e326e70091d265442122c8b1e3`.
It retains upstream identity and `system.source.license: CC-BY-4.0`.
Rules text is SRD 5.2.1 content, Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The fixture makes exact canonical regeneration independent of ignored raw sources.

`_source/spells24/2nd-level/moonbeam.yml` is also an unchanged snapshot from
the same pinned Foundry commit, with SHA-256
`9085b1b6d4a090f32b0bbccb4cd2e5e1d5886bef05a03e021b438eebc1e13949`.
Its missing structured Cylinder height is explicitly corrected to 40 ft by the
source-reviewed SRD 5.2.1 pp.150–151 translation; runtime never reads that prose.
